_about: Tunehold brand file. sweep.py (--config) reads avoid, domains and colors; listing.py reads avoid (copy it into replica/launch/listing.json); replica-deploy runs the sweep with this file. Every other key is information for people and later phases and is ignored by the tools. Screening checks, not legal clearance: see replica/brand.md.
name: Tunehold

labels_to_avoid._about: The original's feature and tier names. Not read by sweep.py --config, because plain words like Wrapped, Jam or Premium would flood it with false hits. Check sweep_with_avoid with: python3 .claude/skills/replica-brand/sweep.py . --avoid "Liked Songs,Smart Shuffle,Discover Weekly,Daily Mix" (no --config: adding it also reports the 9 instruction lines listed in replica/brand.md#sweep, so it always exits 1; without it, exit 0 means clean). check_by_eye: words that sweep.py, which matches names in any case, would also flag in approved copy, so check them by eye. That is why "Your Library" is there: the sweep would flag the approved body text "your library". Check the Title-case label with a case-sensitive grep: grep -rnI --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=replica "Your Library" . (no output means clean).
